description: Phát hiện từ t-076d (lead), chưa xác minh: trong Node, TextDecoder('euc-jp') decode 22 8c 22 8c (UTF-16LE '谢谢') ra '""' mà không báo lỗi, byte 0x8C biến mất thay vì thành U+FFFD. Có thể chỉ xảy ra với Node ICU. Cần thử lại trên Chrome; nếu lặp lại thì decodeBytes đang đếm thiếu chuỗi byte không hợp lệ trong trường hợp này.

handoff.summary: NO-CHANGE outcome for t-8158: Chrome does not reproduce dropped 0x8C bytes. Real Google Chrome 154.0.8037.98 (local /Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome, headless via installed playwright-core) decoding EUC-JP 22 8c 22 8c returns escaped text \"\uFFFD\"\uFFFD, code points [U+0022,U+FFFD,U+0022,U+FFFD], replacementCount=2; fatal:true throws TypeError: Failed to execute 'decode' on 'TextDecoder': The encoded data was not valid. Side-by-side Node v26.3.0 / ICU 78.3 returns escaped text \"\u008C\"\u008C, code points [U+0022,U+008C,U+0022,U+008C], replacementCount=0; fatal:true succeeds with same text. Thus on current Node these are invisible C1 control characters, not lost bytes. Existing decodeBytes strict-then-replacement-count path will report Chrome invalid sequences. No code edits or commit, as required by non-reproduction branch.
scope: No project files modified; .alp/tasks changes from main left untouched
verification: Executed Node ESM inline probe importing project's playwright-core, using identical serializable probe function in Node and page.evaluate in actual installed Google Chrome; exit 0.
Single 8c: Chrome U+FFFD / fatal TypeError; Node U+008C / fatal success.
Controls 22 22 and a4 a2: both runtimes returned respectively U+0022 U+0022 and U+3042, zero replacements and fatal success.
git status confirms only pre-existing .alp task changes; no source edits. pnpm check/browser and independent review not required for no-change branch.
risks: Evidence covers installed Chrome 154.0.8037.98 and Node v26.3.0 / ICU 78.3, not every browser/Node version.
Only this assigned Codex lead session ran; no peer/reviewer or other model launched. Runtime does not expose a reliable self-model/effort identifier to report beyond the assignment configuration.

closed.summary: Not a bug in the browser; no code change. Lead (codex:gpt-6-astra low) showed in real Chrome 154 that EUC-JP 22 8c 22 8c decodes to U+0022 U+FFFD U+0022 U+FFFD (fatal throws), so decodeBytes reports it correctly. Node 26 / ICU 78 maps 0x8C to the invisible C1 control U+008C, which only looked like a dropped byte. Main reproduced both independently: Node [22,8c,22,8c], Chrome [22,fffd,22,fffd].
